Welcome to Fungal Ecology Cardiff, the official website for the internationally-renowned fungi group at Cardiff University. Led by Professor Lynne Boddy and Dr Sarah Christofides, we research many kinds of fungal interactions in the environment. We specialise in tree-associated fungi, particularly wood-decay basidiomycetes. In these pages you can find information on our team, research, and educational activities.

We are based in [Cardiff School of Biosciences](https://www.cardiff.ac.uk/biosciences/) and affiliated to the [Organisms and Environment](https://www.cardiff.ac.uk/biosciences/research/organisms-and-environment) research division.

*Disclaimer: all content on this website represents the views of individual members of the fungi team, and not Cardiff University or the School of Biosciences.*
